title: 1.2 Plate Tectonics Theory
description: The lithosphere, asthenosphere, major plates, and the development of plate tectonic theory. Easy level.

questions.question: Which layer allows the lithosphere to slide across the top of it?
What does the lithosphere consist of?
options: The crust and the uppermost mantle
questions.correctAnswer: The crust and the uppermost mantle

questions.question: About how many large plates make up the lithosphere?
At what rate do tectonic plates typically move?
When was plate tectonic theory developed?
What is a tectonic plate?
options: A large piece of the lithosphere
questions.correctAnswer: A large piece of the lithosphere

questions.question: Where do plates meet one another?
What types of rock can make up a tectonic plate?
options: An increase of 1.4 to 5.8 degrees Celsius
It is when satellites were first launched
Continental rocks, oceanic rocks, or both
Warming has accelerated in recent decades
questions.correctAnswer: Continental rocks, oceanic rocks, or both

questions.question: Which plate includes the western half of the North Atlantic seafloor?
Where may plate boundaries be located?
options: They suggested the continents were once joined
The Atlantic Ocean once covered all continents
Rising seas push salt into freshwater aquifers
Beneath an ocean rather than along a coastline
questions.correctAnswer: Beneath an ocean rather than along a coastline
